record.question:
get the ratio of the primary tumor locations of patients who have early onset. Save the output as `primary_tumor_ratio` with two columns:
- Location
- Count
record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the data
data_clinical_patient = pd.read_csv("/workdir/data_clinical_patient.csv")

# Filter for early onset patients
early_onset_patients = data_clinical_patient[data_clinical_patient['AGE_CATEGORY'] == 'Early Onset']

# Get the value counts of primary tumor locations
primary_tumor_counts = early_onset_patients['PRIMARY_SITE_TRI'].value_counts()

# Calculate the ratio
primary_tumor_ratio = primary_tumor_counts / primary_tumor_counts.sum()

primary_tumor_ratio = primary_tumor_ratio.reset_index()
primary_tumor_ratio.columns = ["Location", "Count"]

# Plot the ratio
primary_tumor_ratio.plot(kind='bar')
plt.title('Ratio of Primary Tumor Locations for Early Onset Patients')
plt.xlabel('Primary Tumor Location')
plt.ylabel('Ratio')
plt.savefig("primary_tumor_ratio.png")
plt.show()
", "test_cases": "assert abs(primary_tumor_ratio["Count"].max()-0.6122448979591837) < 1e-8

assert abs(primary_tumor_ratio["Count"].min()-0.1683673469387755) < 1e-8

assert len(set(primary_tumor_ratio["Location"].tolist()) - set(['Gastric', 'GEJ (Siewert I-II)', 'Esophageal'])) == 0"}
